data.abstract: GlobalGeoTree consists of 6.3 million geolocated tree occurrences, representing 275 families, 2,734 genera, and 21,001 species across hierarchical taxonomic levels. Every record in GlobalGeoTree adheres to open data licenses (e.g., CC0 1.0, CC-BY-4.0, etc.), with source dataset attribution preserved for each sample.
